subject.title: fix(settings): deep merge nested retry provider fields

question: Should OpenClaw accept recursive plain-object merging for settings scopes here, and should this PR be the canonical landing path over the sibling candidate PRs?
rationale: The code fix matches the helper's documented recursive intent, but it changes upgrade behavior for nested settings and there are multiple viable open PRs with different helper and test tradeoffs.

options.title: Land this PR as canonical
options.body: Accept recursive nested settings semantics and use this branch's helper plus global/project/runtime regression coverage as the landing path after exact-head CI.

options.title: Port coverage to a sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer another branch, port this PR's useful coverage or helper shape there before closing the duplicates.

options.title: Narrow to retry.provider
options.body: Limit the change to the observed `retry.provider` nested object if broad recursive settings semantics are too risky for upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Land this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Accept recursive nested settings semantics and use this branch's helper plus global/project/runtime regression coverage as the landing path after exact-head CI.
